note: AELORIA (https://aeloria.pokeable.app/) is capture-class: a Vite production build of a procedural bioluminescent world (floating mountains, giant trees, winged riders) served at the origin root on the pokeable.app platform. §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — every github.com reference in the capture is a library credit (pmndrs/postprocessing, pmndrs/zustand, docs.pmnd.rs/react-three-fiber) or a runtime file-path string; no project's own public source repo is referenced or published, so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, single pass verified idempotent — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<name>.pretty.js|css per captured JS/CSS file (capture-relative name, nested dirs flattened with __; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<name>-NN.js of every APP chunk (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Vendor rule — wholeFile sections, never sliced: assets/three-Bf1rlsf7.js (the three.js r169 build) and assets/react-D7cucQ1e.js (the React runtime chunk: React/react-dom/react-reconciler + react-three-fiber + zustand). Merged worker rule — assets/worker-BdHOuDMt.js is a single chunk that starts with the bundled three.js r169 worker core (wholeFile, content-anchored at the classic `__THREE__` module tail) and then carries the app's world builder (statement-aligned slices). Machinery rule — the Vite modulepreload polyfill opening the app entry chunk is wholeFile. Inlined-region rule — the app entry chunk also inlines pmndrs/postprocessing v6.37.1 (license-anchored: `postprocessing v6.37.1 build`, @license Zlib) between the app's camera code and its wing builder; the region is wholeFile, never sliced. Stylesheet rule — assets/index-Ctb6YBeZ.css is wholeFile. Non-standalone parts are skipped sections, indexed but never sliced: a pure trailing export {…} table where one exists. Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html references external resources only (module script, modulepreload links, stylesheet, Google Fonts, the platform's Cloudflare beacon) — zero inline content blocks, so there are no *-inline-N twins and no index-inline-map.json. Identifiers in src/ are the bundle's own minified names — the rename campaign (PLAN §5) is recorded as an open task in README.md, not claimed here. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
